item.tib: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid o tri ya/ basma ra sngags kyi bdag po der 'dus nas dgra bgegs glo bur thug 'phrad byung ba'i dus/ btsan rgod myur ba srog len gnad nas bskul
item.coloph: sa ma ya kha tham rgya/ btsan rgod myur ba srog len gnad nas bskul ba 'di/ spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo nyer mkho ru/ phyogs gcig bkod pas bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod/ rnam 'byor 'dod pa'i 'phrin las rgyas 'gyur cig shing mo hor zla brgyad pa'i sa sbrul hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gang gi dbang pos sod/ sarba mang ga lam//
